svg.title: Six layers keep their Queries and share three KV banks
svg.desc: A stores six banks, KV-L1 through KV-L6, with 96 components. B has L1/L2 read KV-L1, L3/L4 read KV-L3 and L5/L6 read KV-L5, totaling three banks and 48 components. Both retain six Queries and sequential activation flow.
